This vertical editorial illustration features a portrait of a man from the chest up against a muted greenish-grey background. He has short dark hair, a mustache, and wears glasses with thin metal frames. Around his neck hangs a black and silver stethoscope. He wears a collared shirt with a green, brown, and tan camouflage pattern.

The man’s right hand is raised, holding a large silver metal and glass syringe with a long needle pointing upwards. His hand is positioned in front of his chest.

Large grey block letters across the top read “TEMPO”. Above this, smaller white text reads “MENGAPA PERTAMINA MEMBELI TUBAN PETRO / ASAL-USUL SUAP MEIKARTA”. Below the main title, bold black text reads “KONTROVERSI TERAWAN”. A block of smaller black text follows: “BENARKAH MENTERI KESEHATAN LOLOS DARI SANKSI ETIK BERKAT INTERVENSI MILITER? TEMPO DAN TIRTO.ID MENELUSURI KEJANGGALAN TERAPI CUCI OTAK TERAWAN.”

The bottom right corner displays a barcode and publication details: “2-8 DESEMBER 2019”, “RP 45.000”, “WWW.TEMPO.CO”, and an ISSN number. A thick red vertical stripe borders the left side.
